Mean age was 41.2 years (SD 11.8) and 47 of 52 respondents (90.4%) were primary care physicians.
Familiarity with the screening guideline was reported by 31 of 40 (77.5%, 95% CI 62.5 to 87.7).

Item A was endorsed by 36 of 38 (94.7%, 95% CI 82.7 to 98.5) and item S by 2 of 37 (5.4%, 95% CI 1.5 to 17.7).

Uncertain responses reached 21 of 39 (53.8%, 95% CI 38.6 to 68.4) for item C and 15 of 36 (41.7%, 95% CI 27.1 to 57.8) for item D.
